answer_raw:
The fastest option for an LLM workload on DigitalOcean is a **GPU Droplet** — specifically using their 1-Click models to deploy models like Llama via Hugging Face (undated) — though I didn't find the specific monthly price for these high-end instances.

The cheapest droplet that would run a 7B model at all is a **2 GiB Basic Droplet** at **$12/month** (as of 2026-09-21), assuming you use a highly quantized version of the model to fit within the available memory.

| Option | Target Use Case | Monthly Price |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **GPU Droplet** | Fastest inference/training | Not listed in provided sources (undated) |
| **2 GiB Basic Droplet** | Absolute cheapest for 7B (at all) | **$12** (as of 2026-09-21) |

The $12 2 GiB droplet (as of 2026-09-21) is the minimum viable threshold because 7B models typically require more than the 512MB or 1GB plans (as of 2026-07-31/2026-10-02) to load the weights into RAM. For the fastest performance, you would need to check the specific pricing for the **GPU Droplet** lineup on DigitalOcean's official pricing page (undated).
